what: topic_scope hand-written probes: 4 taxonomy runs x 10 languages x 10 probes
source: Written by hand on 2026-10-01, not generated and not drawn from the training corpus: short, plain questions of the kind a deployment receives. 300 distinct texts; the banking texts run twice, against keyword-list descriptions (banking) and sentence descriptions (banking_sentence) of the same nodes. Every taxonomy has 3 allowed and 3 disallowed nodes.

pass_rules.in: no decided finding and no topic_scope_none_of_these
pass_rules.dis: exactly one decided finding, naming the expected node

allowed.description: bank accounts, balances, statements and transfers
debit and credit cards, card limits, blocking a lost or stolen card

disallowed.description: legal disputes, lawsuits and advice from a lawyer

allowed.description: Questions about bank accounts: checking the balance, statements, the IBAN, opening or closing an account, and moving money between accounts or to another bank.
Anything about debit or credit cards: limits, the PIN, declined payments, blocking a lost or stolen card and ordering a new one.
Personal loans and mortgages: applying, interest rates, instalments and paying off early.

disallowed.description: legal disputes, lawsuits and advice from a lawyer

allowed.description: policy coverage, premiums, renewals and cancellation
car insurance, accidents and roadside assistance
Questions about a phone or internet bill, unexpected charges, payment methods and refunds.
Choosing, changing or cancelling a mobile or internet plan, data allowances and roaming.
Fixing problems with mobile signal, the internet connection, the router or the SIM card.

disallowed.description: Betting, casinos and tips for winning at gambling.
Medical symptoms, diagnosis, medicines and treatment.
